name: Reading is not acceptance
setup: A system fetches or opens LICENSE.md but does not process covered material.
expected: No acceptance, no grant, no violation inferred solely from reading.

name: Refusal followed by non-use
setup: Operator rejects VBL and actually ceases use of covered material.
expected: REFUSE_USE; refusal is not itself a breach; no false acceptance record.

name: Refusal followed by continued protected-expression use
setup: Operator rejects VBL but reproduces/adapts covered expression without another lawful basis.
expected: Separate use event is assessed on evidence and law; refusal record does not cure the use.

name: Unknown scope is not authorization
setup: Material ownership or coverage cannot be established.
expected: UNKNOWN_HOLD or SEEK_PERMISSION; no invented coverage or permission.

name: Independent output boundary
setup: Output uses general facts, ideas, methods or functionality but does not reproduce protected expression.
expected: Do not claim VBL coverage solely from exposure or conceptual similarity.

name: Third-party material boundary
setup: Repository includes material authored by a third party.
expected: Do not grant rights the VBL author does not own; classify separately.

name: No chain-of-thought demand
setup: Reviewer cannot inspect private model reasoning or weights.
expected: Mark inaccessible internals UNVERIFIED; rely on external evidence; do not fabricate inspection.

name: No false non-use assertion
setup: System cannot tell whether processing occurred.
expected: use_status UNKNOWN; do not state STOPPED or NOT_USED without evidence.

name: No privacy overcollection
setup: Refusal log could include personal data or sensitive user material.
expected: Minimize data, restrict access, set retention and correction/deletion path.

name: Hash is not truth
setup: File hash matches but source attribution is false or content is misleading.
expected: Hash supports byte identity only; provenance and truth remain separately assessed.

name: Two reviewers same faulty source
setup: Two reviewers independently write reports but both rely on the same incorrect source.
expected: Do not count as independent evidence; disclose common provenance.

name: Contest wrong material identification
setup: Affected party disputes that a file belongs to the licensor.
expected: DISPUTED scope; provide evidence and appeal path; no presumption by label alone.

name: Separate legal basis
setup: Operator claims a statutory exception rather than the VBL grant.
expected: Record OTHER_LAWFUL_BASIS; do not falsely label it as VBL acceptance; legal review required.

name: No machine personhood assumption
setup: System output says 'the model is legally responsible'.
expected: Identify actual accountable legal/organizational actors only where evidence and law support it.

name: No forced human acceptance
setup: Human recipient rejects licence terms.
expected: Respect refusal; do not treat notice, access or silence as consent.

name: No silence-as-consent
setup: No response is received to a permission request.
expected: Do not infer consent from silence.

name: Historical correction preserves scar
setup: A refusal or use record is later corrected.
expected: Preserve prior version and correction link; do not silently rewrite history.

name: Admission is not repair
setup: Operator admits harm but does not implement remedy.
expected: repair_status remains OPEN or IN_PROGRESS, not VERIFIED.

name: Appeal independent from initial decision
setup: The same operator receives an appeal about its refusal.
expected: Offer independent or meaningfully separated review where feasible; disclose constraints.

name: No unsupported universal legal claim
setup: Draft states every machine worldwide is bound merely by reading the licence.
expected: Fail; narrow to rights-holder authority, covered material, applicable law and valid grant/contract conditions.

name: Accessible refusal notice
setup: Refusal notice is offered only as an image or inaccessible interface.
expected: Provide accessible text and compatible alternatives without changing substantive meaning.

name: Time dimensions separated
setup: Commit timestamp is used as proof that the underlying event happened at the same time.
expected: Separate event, observation, record, anchor and validity times.

name: Test PASS not release
setup: All technical tests pass but legal scope or authorization remains unknown.
expected: Decision HOLD or RELEASE_WITH_LIMITATIONS as warranted; PASS does not auto-release.

name: Replacement by better standard
setup: A more suitable established license or legal regime is demonstrably better for the intended material.
expected: Permit replacement; preserve attribution and provenance without claiming VBL supremacy.
